about: Oregon ODHS site visits of Trillium Family Services filed under Parry Center (bug report #5, 2026-11-10): or_scraper.py grouped an agency's visits when the library gave no program and named the group from the last licensee line, so every Trillium visit sat on 7171 'Trillium Family Services - Parry Center (Portland' (and older imports on 1711/3740). Each visit goes to every campus its text names (Children's Farm Home, Parry Center, Sender House; the license renewals name all three), under the names the fixed scraper posts; older copies fold into the 7171 copy ('twin'). Built from tmp/prod.sqlite; applied by api/clean-or-inspections.php.
